observations: Photo 0: Industrial flatbed sewing machine mounted on a wooden table with drawers.
Machine body is white/cream colored with visible paint wear, rust spots, and scratches on the top casing.
Brand name 'FLY' printed on the front of the machine head.
Thread spool and bobbin winder visible on the right side.
Machine foot and needle area show some surface grime and oxidation.
Wooden table top has stains, scuffs, and a crack line near the front edge.
Drawers under the table show wear and discoloration.
Background shows a shop interior with people and other equipment, partially obscured.
Watermark overlay reads 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'INNARA COLLECTION'.
